intro: Every request for a yes in one place: the ones you asked for, the ones asked of you, and what you decided. Open a request to see whom it asked, what each said, and where its document stands now.
start: Open My requests to see what you are waiting on, and who has it.
Open Asked of me to see what waits for your decision. You decide it in your Inbox.
Ask whoever manages approvals to set up the policies, in People and access › Approvals, if nothing ever waits.

articles.title: Find out where a request stands
articles.summary: See who a request is waiting on and for how long, and read every decision, reminder and hand-over.

steps.rest: Each row says who it is waiting on and for how long.
to see a short card, then View more for the whole history.
It lists every decision with its note, every reminder and every hand-over.

tips: Overdue means a step is past the deadline its policy gave it. Escalated means it was handed up to someone else when the deadline passed.
The numbers beside the statuses follow the tab and your filters. Waiting holds the overdue and escalated ones too.

articles.title: Approve or decline a request
articles.summary: Requests asked of you are decided in your Inbox. Approve moves the document on; Decline needs a reason the person who asked will read.

steps.rest: or press Decide in your Inbox on a request waiting on you.
Add a note if you decline: the person who asked reads it.

articles.after: The last approval a request needs, or any decline, settles it, and its document moves on at once. What you decided is listed under I decided, with your note.
tips: A second step only reaches its approvers once the step before it is approved.
On some money documents, the person who submitted it cannot approve it, unless your organisation allows it.

articles.title: Take back a request you made
articles.summary: Withdraw a request that is still waiting. Its document goes back to where it was before it was submitted.

steps.lead: Open the menu on its row, or the request itself.
steps.rest: Only a waiting request can be withdrawn.
The document goes back to where it was before it was submitted.

tips: To find an old approval, choose Asked of me, I decided or All requests, then press a status, or set a kind of document, a person or dates. All requests needs permission.
